title: MGS MOC filename
reference: MGS MOC RDR SIS, §3.1 (Data Product Naming and Organization); MOC SDP/EDR SIS (mocsis), §PRODUCT_ID

segments.label: Cycle
segments.description: Three-character mission cycle or phase the image was taken in.

segments.label: Image number
segments.description: Sequential image number within that cycle; together with the cycle it forms the MOC product ID.

segments.label: Camera / filter
segments.description: Instrument, or instrument and global-filter, designation.

GB.meaning: Wide angle global map swath, blue filter
GB.description: A non-targeted daily global map swath, typically a full planet scan, taken through the wide angle camera's blue filter.

GR.meaning: Wide angle global map swath, red filter
GR.description: As "gb" but through the wide angle camera's red filter.

NA.description: A commanded narrow angle frame — MOC's high-resolution camera.

WB.description: A commanded wide angle frame, often the context image for a narrow angle observation.

WR.description: As "wb" but through the red filter.

values.IMQ: MOC-compressed image as returned by the instrument, which needs the mission's decompression tool before use
